gloss: to come forward; to volunteer; to identify oneself

definitions.gloss: to come forward; to volunteer; to step forward
definitions.explanation: To present oneself voluntarily to take on a task, responsibility, or role.

definitions.gloss: to identify oneself; to reveal one's identity
definitions.explanation: To announce who one is, especially when sought or when identity was previously unknown.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{名乗|なの}る→名乗る：11874_nanoru⟧ (to give one's name, to call oneself) and ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to come out). The ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ component adds the sense of stepping forward from a group or emerging publicly.

USAGE:
- Often used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to indicate the role or purpose: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{名乗|なの}り{出|で}る (to volunteer for ~)
- ⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧{名乗|なの}り{出|で}る emphasizes doing so of one's own initiative
- In sense 2, often involves revealing oneself to authorities or the public

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{名乗|なの}り{出|で}る: to volunteer
- ⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧{名乗|なの}り{出|で}る: to come forward of one's own accord
- ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{名乗|なの}り{出|で}る: to turn oneself in to the police
- ⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{名乗|なの}り{出|で}る: to put oneself forward as a candidate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{志願|しがん}する→志願する：11342_shigansuru⟧: to volunteer, apply — more formal; often used for military or official contexts
- ⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run as a candidate — specifically for elections
- ⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}る→申し出る：10465_moushideru⟧: to offer, propose — broader; can be used for requests and suggestions
- ⟦{自首|じしゅ}→自首：23257_jishu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to turn oneself in — specifically to police; stronger than {名乗|なの}り{出|で}る in legal contexts
